_comment: Copy this to the scratch folder, fill it, run: python3 scripts/thumbnail.py check spec.json, then render. Paths may be relative to this file. Fields starting with _ are ignored.
title: The video's own title, exactly as it will be published
hook: Three to five words in the founder's language, currency as they wrote it; put | where you want a line break on 16:9, for example: $3.40 in, | 40 cents left. In Chinese, Japanese or Thai, a space marks where a line may break and is not drawn
lang: optional: ja, ko, zh-Hans, zh-Hant, zh-HK, tr and so on; picks regional letterforms and casing. Leave empty for most hooks
highlight: the word, or a number with its unit (up to three words, for example ₹5.2 lakh), to set larger, colour or box; or empty
_highlight_scale: 0.8 to 2.2; raise it when the founder asks for the key word or figure bigger
focal: a number with its unit, shown in a chip; or empty. Use highlight or focal, not both
_focal_scale: size of the focal chip, 0.6 to 2.6

poster.hook: a second word option, drawn in this style

_styles: per style: hook, highlight, focal, focal_scale, highlight_scale, photo_offset, face_scale, case, subject_side. Each style carries a different word option so the founder sees them drawn
_photo_offset: move the photo [right, down] as fractions of the frame, for example [0.05, 0] is 64 px right at 1280; a strip the photo no longer covers is filled with a blurred extension of the same photo
_text_width: 0.40 to 0.70: how much of the 16:9 frame the words' side takes in panel, poster and cinema; widen it first when the founder wants the words bigger
_text_position: top, center or bottom to move the block of words; empty keeps the style's own
_weight_boost: 0 to 1: thickens the letters when the founder asks for bolder and no heavier weight is installed
_face_scale: 0.6 to 1.4; smaller makes room for bigger words
spelling: us for American spelling in the notes and sheet; leave empty otherwise
photo: path to the founder's photo, or empty for a words-only thumbnail
photo_kind: face, or object for a photo of the product or the work
_face_box: left, top, right, bottom as fractions of the photo, hair to chin, ear to ear; read it off the inspect grid
cutout: path to a PNG of the founder with the background already removed, only for the cutout style

brand._named: colours given by name without a code, for example ["cream"]; check refuses to draw until they are settled with the colours or swatches command
brand.ground: optional: force the dark background colour
brand.font: optional: path to the founder's font file, or an installed family name
brand.logo: optional: path to a logo PNG; it goes top corner on the words' side

_directions: panel, poster, cinema, cutout, type (old names split, card, bleed still work)
_sizes: youtube 1280x720, widescreen 1920x1080, square 1080x1080, vertical 1080x1920, podcast 3000x3000; the first is the one compared
promise: what the title and the thumbnail together promise, in plain words
payoff: what in the video delivers it

reasons.panel: one line on why this style suits this video

out_dir: /mnt/user-data/outputs/thumbnails on claude.ai; thumbnails in a working folder
